rows.name: vendored-tables-equal
args: import sys;A,W=sys.argv[1:3];n='docs/coop/design-corrections/native/';r=[open(A+'/'+n+f,'rb').read()==open(W+'/crates/components/data/'+f,'rb').read() for f in ('protocol3-transitions.v1.json','typescript-protocol2-order.v1.json')];print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(r) else 1)

rows.name: package-edges
args: import json,subprocess,sys;R,PY,A,W=sys.argv[1:5];m=subprocess.run([R+'cargo','metadata','--format-version','1','--offline','--locked'],capture_output=True,check=True,cwd=W).stdout;open(sys.argv[5],'wb').write(m);r=subprocess.run([PY,'-I','-B','tools/check_package_edges.py','--repository',W,'--metadata',sys.argv[5],'--inventory',A+'/'+json.load(open(W+'/design-lock.json'))['inventorySuccessors'][-1]['candidate']['path'],'--lane','host','--package-policy',A+'/docs/implementation/m3/operability/o1-package-policy-r1/package-policy.json','--architecture',A,'--lock','design-lock.json'],cwd=W,capture_output=True);sys.stdout.write(r.stdout.decode()+r.stderr.decode());j=json.loads(r.stdout);e=sorted((x['to'],x['kinds'][0]['kind'] or 'normal') for x in j['resolvedInternalEdges'] if x['from']=='opensip-components');print(e);sys.exit(0 if j['passed'] and e==[('opensip-contracts','normal'),('opensip-identity','normal')] else 1)

rows.name: census-closure-unchanged
args: import re,sys,subprocess;src=open('tools/security/discovery_census.py').read();closure=set(re.findall(r"\('(crates/[^']+)', \d+, '[0-9a-f]{64}'\)",src));changed=set(subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/git','diff','--name-only','HEAD']).decode().split())|set(subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard']).decode().split());hit=sorted(closure&changed);print(len(closure),'closure files;',sorted(changed),'changed; hit',hit);sys.exit(1 if hit or len(closure)<10 else 0)
